main_text.p: fonam fono breviffimo & celer- rimo fequenti adjicit.
Scheva poft vocalem brevem fub litera non dageffata, & in fine dictionis etiam geminum, quiescit.
Ultima litera vocali carens, præcedenti conjungitur.
Differentia Kametz ex præ- ceptis Grammaticis petenda.
Accentus cujusque vocis eft in ultima vel penultima : fi alius præterea adfit, is euphoniæ in- fervit.
Vox accentu carens, per interjectam virgulam fequenti alligatur, unde Cholem & Tzere ultimæ syllabæ folent corripi.

page.notes: Hebrew terms (Scheva, Kametz, Cholem, Tzere, Makkaph) are printed in roman type; no Hebrew characters appear on this page. Scan has heavy stains and show-through at the edges, not transcribed. The final line ")( 7" is a signature-style mark with page number 7.
